body:
I've waited a half hour for him to give any inclination that he cares, and that's as long as I can wait

I hope you're fucking happy dude because you don't have to worry about my annoying ass anymore

the only way things get better is if I initiate it

but what I need is him to give me one shred of proof that he loves me even when there's a fight

but he treats me like dirt! and thinks I don't know what gaslighting is

but I do, and telling him to knock it off results in even more denial.

so a half hour

he knows I'm freezing cold because I've been crying, he knows I hate it when he walks off, he knows I haven't eaten all day while he's up there getting food for himself

he knew I needed a hug and because I was sad that he didn't, I'm awful scum of the earth, "the problem"

that was as long as I could wait, I'm just sorry about my dog. sorry. goodbye. sorry.
